profile.name: Carl Anthony Magumpara
profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.bio: Based in the Philippines, I am a full-stack software engineer specializing in Laravel, React, and React Native. I design and build reliable APIs, well-structured data models, and polished interfaces—delivering maintainable web and mobile products from concept to production.

bullets: Develop full-stack web applications using Laravel for backend and frontend technologies like React.
Design and implement RESTful APIs, database schemas, and user interfaces.
Stay updated with Laravel framework updates and best practices.
Develop and maintain mobile applications using React Native.
Develop, test, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
Ensure code quality, performance, and responsiveness of applications.
